local_learn.observation: The benchmark Candidate successfully enforced representative coverage, contamination controls, exactly-once evidence, and claim separation, but a mechanically failed case plus a demonstrable instruction-scorer vocabulary mismatch means the evidence is diagnostic rather than activation-grade.

contradictory_evidence: The fixed success threshold was 12 of 12 plus a clean audit, but the mechanical result was 11 of 12 and therefore FAIL.

The public instruction requested verification while the frozen invariant scorer required the literal substring verify; the response supplied a verification field and verification action, but did not contain the literal verify token.
The evaluator and scorer are repository-authored, the serving model identity is externally unverified, and the executor was not an independently operated production verifier.
The measurement and native records have not yet been published through a new unchanged exact-head CI result.
result.reason: The Candidate materially improved evidence discipline: the trial froze a representative two-per-criterion suite, separated generator, executor, and scorer identities, kept evaluator-only material out of the child context, bound one immutable response to the exact request, reproduced deterministic scores, and kept the bounded, Candidate, AGI-claim, and user-level verdicts separate. However, the precommitted all-cases threshold mechanically failed at 11 of 12, and the lone failure exposes a public-instruction-to-scorer lexical mismatch between verification and the literal token verify. That mismatch cannot be repaired retroactively, the serving model identity remains unverified, and one repository-authored internal trial is insufficient for scoped activation.
required_next_evidence: Preserve this trial, response, scorer report, and FAIL verdict immutably; do not retry or rescore it under changed semantics.
Precommit a minimal instruction-scorer contract repair that aligns the public concept vocabulary and deterministic invariant without revealing expected answers or weakening the fixed threshold.
Add regression tests proving that the public instruction and scorer share the same explicit concept contract, missing concepts still fail closed, and historical trial artifacts remain unchanged.
After the repair is independently validated and published, generate a fresh secret-seeded suite and obtain a new single response from a separate non-writing executor; do not reuse this response.
Keep Candidate activation blocked until fresh repeat evidence and the separate deterministic protected-baseline gate support it.
result.rollback: Remain at NEED_MORE_EVIDENCE. Preserve the current mechanical FAIL and immutable artifacts, make no active prompt change, perform no Candidate promotion, and select a separately precommitted repair or fresh stronger measurement at the next Root boundary.
